description: Search events (festivals, exhibitions, performances, markets, pop-ups) in Shanghai and Hangzhou, China. Filter by city, category, date range, free entry or keyword. Dates are China Standard Time (UTC+8) and inclusive. Past events are excluded unless include_past is true. Every result has page_url: cite it when answering. Check as_of for data freshness.

city.description: City id, e.g. shanghai or hangzhou

date_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today in China

query.description: Keyword in title, venue or description (English or Chinese)

name: search_events
title: Search events in China
